headings.rules: Never center by default. Use tracking-tight for sizes > 32px. No Inter/Roboto. Avoid Space Grotesk.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with The Performance Pro
colors.rules: No purple. No teal. Tinted greys only (cool undertone). Explicit hover text colors required. Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for small text. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky chat headers and floating menus. bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/5.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders (border-border). No soft shadows on cards, use crisp borders.
visual_enhancers.radius: Subtle roundness. sm: 4px, md: 6px, lg: 8px (rounded-lg max). Pill shape for primary actions.
visual_enhancers.animations: Micro-interactions on hover. Staggered list entrances for chat lists. Framer motion for modal entrances.
visual_enhancers.ai_styling: Swell AI chat bubbles should have a subtle 1px border of ai_swell_accent and a distinct background (surface_hover with ai_swell_accent/5). No generic AI emojis.

layouts.general: Dense, full-height (h-screen) application layout. Avoid Bootstrap grids.
layouts.sidebar: Tight spacing (w-16 or w-64). Fixed left. Grid hierarchy.
layouts.chat_area: Stateful transcript view. Messages group consecutive turns. Stick to bottom.
layouts.user_profile: Bento grid layout for personality insights. Asymmetric spans.
layouts.forms: Multi-step quiz using Shadcn Forms with progress bar.

components.shadcn_usage: Use Shadcn for Dropdowns, Dialogs, Forms, Inputs, Avatar, ScrollArea, Tabs, Progress. Customize borders to be sharp (rounded-md max).
components.icons: Phosphor Icons for a crisp, high-end technical feel (Duotone for nav, Regular for actions).

features_spec.auth: Split screen. Left: Modern form. Right: Office teamwork image with heavy black/60 overlay and brand text.
features_spec.chat: Left sidebar (teams/calls/files), middle chat list, right main chat window. Message bubbles with timestamps on hover.
features_spec.swell_ai: Distinct AI persona. Quick action prompts in a horizontal scroll above input. Use AI avatar.
features_spec.quiz: 16-personalities style. Progress bar on top. Questions centered. End with bento-style results.
features_spec.video_call: Placeholder screen with large avatars in a CSS Grid (1x2 or 2x2), floating controls at bottom.

ai_branding.description: Iridescent fluid shape for AI empty state
Blue fluid abstract shape for Swell AI avatar

backgrounds.description: Modern office teamwork for auth side screen

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. No generic centered layouts.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs/headers.
Use modern button styles (sharp rounded-md) with distinct interaction animations.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Never use AI assistant emojis (🤖🧠💭). Use abstract geometric icons or the provided AI avatar image.
Every interactive element MUST have a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for complex layout grids (Bento), but Shadcn for interactive logic (Dialogs, Select, Forms).
